title: The Brimstone Spring
text: A yellow spring bubbles out of the rock, scalding, crusted with sulphur, and the smell of it is rot and eggs and burnt hair. Pit-folk bathe here and come out red and raw. A body that bathes in it, they say, comes out harder.

options.label: The hardiest bathes in the scalding spring, hoping to come out harder.

outcomes.text: It hurts more than anything ever has. They come out red and raw and harder.
It hurts more than anything ever has, and some of it does not stop, and never will.

options.label: Bottle some to sell. The apothecaries will pay for anything this vile.

outcomes.text: Stinking, scalding, and the apothecaries in town will pay for it.

options.label: Keep well away from it. Nothing that smells like that is a blessing.

outcomes.text: The smell follows you for a day, rot and eggs and burnt hair.
